inputs: stdin: newline-delimited UTF-8 JSON {id: positive safe integer, paths: 1..128 absolute Windows drive paths}; at most 1 MiB per frame and 32767 UTF-16 units per path; the Node caller serializes requests and applies a 30-second inspection deadline including startup/replacement, clamped to the remaining operation budget
The Node caller requires acknowledged close before replacement and separately bounds close/reap to 10 seconds
outputs: stdout: one compact UTF-8 JSON {id, rows:[{ok:boolean,reparsePoint:boolean}]} frame per valid request, at most 1 MiB; paths/errors are never echoed
exit 0 on clean EOF; exit 2 on invalid framing/input/protocol/runtime failure; failed attribute lookup returns ok=false/reparsePoint=true
bindings: Target: installed stock Windows PowerShell 5.1, also syntax-checked with pwsh; no elevation, reboot, installation or execution-policy changes
Single inseparable script; no functions, assemblies, module members, imports, dynamic commands, callbacks or external executables
Built-in Set-StrictMode, New-Object, ConvertFrom-Json, ConvertTo-Json; .NET Console/Text/StringBuilder/IO.File/FileAttributes APIs
Script-local variables only; ErrorActionPreference=Stop and StrictMode=2 affect this child process; Console input/output encodings are process-local UTF-8
effects: Reads filesystem attributes only via IO.File.GetAttributes; follows no content and writes no filesystem/registry/network state
Reads stdin and writes protocol stdout only; errors are fixed/closed, never raw exceptions
Node parent launches a fixed absolute OS executable and fixed script with NoProfile/NonInteractive/File, no shell or policy bypass, and kills/reaps on timeout or corruption
tests: Authored transport tests exercise correlation, bounds, timeout and close/reap; native temporary-file/junction behavior must pass before operational reuse
limitations: Attribute attestation is a point-in-time check, not atomic directory-handle traversal or a hostile-filesystem sandbox
Caller-owned absolute paths and parent resource controls remain required; this helper does not select an AddOns root or execute Lua/XML
